name: Bongwater
look: a little round glass flask half full of water with a tall glass neck, a brass downstem and bowl and big eyes
entry: Its belly gurgles with every breath it draws through its glass neck. The water inside slowly turns brown, and it has to swim in clean rivers to rinse itself out.
how: Wild: common in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto).
It learns Bubble Filter at level 25.
